intent: Sprint from the lower fields up a zigzagging ridge, cross the summit and descend the far side.

sections.name: The lower fields
sections.lesson: Build a steady rhythm across the fields

signs.text:
The lower fields
Build a steady rhythm across the fields

The zigzag ascent
Reverse around the hillside’s shoulders

sections.name: The rocky ridge
sections.lesson: Brake on the broad rocks before the next cut

signs.text:
The rocky ridge
Brake on the broad rocks before the next cut

sections.name: The exposed summit
sections.lesson: Gain the top against the wind

signs.text:
The exposed summit
Gain the top against the wind

sections.name: The rapid descent
sections.lesson: Follow the terraces down the far side

signs.text:
The rapid descent
Follow the terraces down the far side
